**Generate QR Code**

this repository serves as engine to generate QR code based on url. 

Usecase:

send POST http request to url `http://localhost:3000` then add response body

> ```json
> {
>   "url": "John Doe",
> }
> ```

The results will be:

<img src="data:image/png;base64,">

You can also change the size of generated qr code by set the `scale` value.
